title: The Hand That Stayed

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A hand that cannot close two inches may stay where it cannot reach, and staying is not reaching. The house keeps by not-doing and the boy by not-going; neither is a kindness entered on any slate.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard, told over the trough in Bone's middle week

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and twelve to three hundred and fourteen days, six months and one hundred and thirty-two to one hundred and thirty-four days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register reads the body as a wound inventoried in its old order — crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, frozen thread unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and reads the world the way a trauma bay is read, checking the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; the carried fire kept in fours with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell left in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid with four arithmetics of the year now behind one printed figure, Bone's first reading gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind Frost's three, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space between, four readings four and not one account with the finding on a place of its own and no payer. The dressed grain lies covered under wool at the rack end, turned with a progressively lighter touch and read over on Bone 10 by a number that does not know what it cost; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays the fourth of four held changes on four places and not a rule; the twice-mended pot lifts on Sella's thumb where the wire crosses the crack with the crack left showing; the seven walked-around places go around with a look and a wide step and no number; the stayed frost gone off the well's north lip, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate on its flat stone stay three coverings called weather and entered nowhere. The chapter's one meaningful change is a small physical fraction on Bone 15, advanced and not paid: the hand outside the wool, having let a small intake go whole on the river's note, stays at the inch for the space of the note's fading instead of coming straight down to the fold — held, not reaching, the two inches still unclosed, filed as answer 203 on a place of its own and expressly not a reach, a gift, a power, a fifth held change or a payer. The surgeon reads it as a clamp left a moment after the bleeding has stopped; the infant reads it as a hand that has not stopped wanting the crust; both are true and neither wins.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Thirteenth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{312}{Bone 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and ninety-eighth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 86. Carry 311 to 312 exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-two days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twelve days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 10, 11 or 12 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — not the reading, not the four arithmetics, not the bell's gap, not the returned half-check. Bone 20 (Day 319), the month's second reading, stands five mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never hurried, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle set beyond his reach. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work, not a virtue (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one: the fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor; the river's water over water under the finger's-width door; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot overhead — agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T061/T082, T088). Sella's grammar of the morning: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; The house will keep it where another woman would say I; finger kept on top of the loaf shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread; lips along a row standing with two gaps and neither figured; one glance at the clay jar and the hand half over nothing; the twice-mended pot lifted with the thumb first where the wire crossed the crack before the weight came on the handle, both proverbs said to the pot and the fire and never to a person, the crack left showing; pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; fold righted without a look at his face; thread left. The widow's mark hangs on its cord and is not touched, because a morning and a hearth are not openings; five openings in five months are five and not a rule and the next stands far off in a later month's first firing (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092). Tarn at the kindling: knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where it can slip, six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt; Six counted. The next I don't count to the wood; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light and giving it back, the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; loan uncalled and no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra at the wheel-shed edge: meal-fine grey slate dust ground past the bent finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip; dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel; speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person; knows the note a pot will give three turns ahead, with air under it and a want in it, and withholds it from a High Kiln kiln-master who would call it early; bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron read with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, pot sayings three with the Smoke 14 note apart, row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; he's not Vail sealed and the promise of the foundling's name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101). The hand comes up an inch and takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the river's low note: answer 199, a restraint and not a payment, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named, not promoted into a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Yard Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 312, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, drying racks and rack end, worked strips as a direction, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, fold over his ears against the river wind, instruction to the wool and the wind and never to the basket. She goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — seven places kept by going around them, no eighth likeness stood up as a row and no number put to any (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). At the yard well the stayed frost gone off the north lip while the yard looked elsewhere, the skin on the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on the flat stone out of the path of feet stay three coverings in three places, all called weather and entered nowhere, a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). Bone's hunts and repairs go on as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: a man come down from Cold Acre with a hare across his shoulders shifts the weight when a woman with a pot asks what the carrying cost and says Ask the weather. It carried the snow; it can carry the price, and goes off toward the north gate road; nobody weighs the hare, nobody opens a slate, and the boy files the answer as a direction and not a figure (T077). A man with a barrow asks what the month's mending will want now the light goes early and is told to ask the pot; the pot, being a pot, says nothing, and no man pricing a repair stands up in the yard to be asked. The yard's refusal to put a number to anything is a care and not a kind of knowledge; he keeps the care on its own place and does not make a doctrine of it, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. At the rack end the dressed grain lies covered under wool and is gone around, not figured; the number that went over it on Bone 10 does not know what it cost and is not brought back as a lesson or mending (T077, T015/T041/T047). Tarn's stroke goes over the shallow bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays on the flagstone's own place with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat — four held changes on four places, not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause, no payer named; a thing kept by not being made again is still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T100, T061/T082). The small keepings stay small and are not brought under the roof: the charcoal under the loaf shelf unread beneath her finger; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve; the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand with a finger between every pair; the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; the burned slate at five; the two shut-room tellings; the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing; the reed-cutter's cord; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth — none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment (T100, T080, T101, T065/T095, T090, T099, T050/T051, T033/T034). Three counts in three places again — fire's four and gap, river's low over lower, boards' four, four and a knot — and none rises into another (T061/T082, T088). At the going of the light she carries him up at the half-pace, sets him under the Vail roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread. The hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the river's note: answer 200, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, carried into neither the fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap left in the square nor the river's low over lower.

scenes.title: The Fourteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{313}{Bone 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the roof into first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 12 or 13 is brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 312 to 313 exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-three days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and thirteen days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: the crust gone stiffer and leathery two inches from the ear, its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody will perform. The composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before worse; the infant wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped, and the surgeon's knowing buys nothing at two inches of air — both true, the second louder, neither wins, and the argument is the work (T060/T086). The finding that four arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure is kept on a place of its own with no payer under it: not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule, and not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain covered and unfigured under wool at the rack end, the four held changes on four places, the returned half-check or the boy's own kept gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031). Four readings are four and not one account; the printed figure stands at one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read is still not the figure paid, no signature stands on the space, and the four true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln. Under the roof the widow's mark is not touched at a shelf, a well, a rack, a morning, a hearth or a bed, because the hand goes to it before the kiln and at no other hour and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack before the weight came on the handle and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack showing; her finger stays on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, her lips move along a row with two gaps and figure neither, and she sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092). At the rack end the dressed grain is turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure and the reading of Bone 10 is not brought back (T077). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside the unforged collector sentence; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops with no figure and no name, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the Seed 16 breath stays unspent, the warm loft stone lies cold in its unmarked pot, the loan stays uncalled and no collector comes up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to wheel and pot before any person, sets his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and grows quieter at the burned-slate saying carried from Bone 5: the fifth telling stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, no sixth due on a day that has not earned one, no witness standing and no hand named at the flame, the seed waiting on the far-off calling-in of his promise, not a confession and not a payment; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). The hand comes up for answer 201: the half-beat of a pot's set-down set beside a small intake with a finger between and neither promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh or a payment — exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Ask the Pot
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 14 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the kindling, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb which she does not scrub out. Asked what the firings of Bone have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there; the short strip of notched birch bark is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the charcoal under the shelf, the cord, the open slate, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both, with a half-beat between the looking and the word; she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice. The boy files the order of reaching as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, files no tenth, makes no figure of the slate's nearness and does not make her a reader of her own keeping (T080 advanced, not paid). She is not Marra, not the soft-handed man, not the soft-cuffed clerk, not Hessa and not the green-mouthed woman at the pot board, and the reading of Bone 10 has not come to her well. The three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather: a cost asked of a repaired jar is sent to the pot with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, and leaves no entry (T077). At the hearth the fire answers four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand and nobody supplies the pull, its payer unnamed three hundred and thirteen days; under the finger's-width door the river goes water over water without a number; overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — three counts in three places and none rises into another (T088, T061/T082). Ilva's strip stays in her sleeve with no tenth hand; the well-saying stays at three shapings beside the eighth hand; the row at five askings; the burned slate at five; the two shut-room tellings; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth — none brought under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment (T080, T101, T065/T095, T050/T051, T033/T034). At the going of the light she carries him up, sets him under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread. The hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, lets it go whole on the river's note and lays itself back against the fold: answer 202, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Hand That Stayed
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{314}{Bone 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the roof into first light of an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 13 or 14 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 313 to 314 exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and fourteen days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: the crust gone stiffer and leathery two inches from the ear, its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third to make the row come out even; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare joint of the wrist where the wool has ridden back, as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody in this house will perform. The composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before worse; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped, both true, the second louder, neither winning, and the argument the work (T060/T086). The house keeps by its not-doings and the boy keeps his finger between its omissions and his own kept gaps; three counts in three places that do not become one (T061/T082). The finding of four arithmetics behind one printed figure is kept on a place of its own with no payer under it, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain under wool, the four held changes on four places, the returned half-check or the boy's own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, gives the instruction to the wool, the wind, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack showing, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along the two-gapped row without figuring either gap, glances once at the clay jar, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. The widow's mark hangs on its cord and is not touched, because a morning, a hearth and a bed are not openings and five openings in five months are five and not a rule; the next stands far off in a later month's first firing (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; the loan stays uncalled and no collector comes (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parts dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, speaks to wheel and pot before any person, sets that finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, grows quieter at the burned-slate saying, and keeps the fifth telling at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, no sixth, no witness, no hand at the flame and no payer; he's not Vail stays sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T060/T086, T061/T082): at the end of the morning the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes the small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same low note — and then, for the first time, does not come straight down to the fold. It stays at the inch for the space of the note's fading, held and not reaching, the two inches still unclosed. The surgeon reads it as a clamp left a moment after the bleeding has stopped, a tourniquet not yet released; the infant reads it as a hand that has not given up wanting the crust; both are true and neither wins. He files it as answer 203, a letting-go followed by a staying at the inch, a new object laid on a place of its own on the sixth place. It closes none of the two inches, is not a reach, a gift, a power, a seventh hearing, a tenth stopping, a fifth held change and has no payer; it is not laid across the house's four held changes on four places, which stay four, and it is not made again at the going of the light in Scene 6 — one staying is a keeping, two would be a habit, and a habit would want a payer.

scenes.title: The File Left Open
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 314, Bone 15, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). The three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere, three places with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The returned half-check stays on the flagstone's own place with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat beside it; four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause, no payer named, and a thing kept by not being made again is still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held). The hand's staying at the inch is not made again at the going of the light: it stays one object on its own place, not a habit, not a fifth held change, not a rule (T060/T086). The four arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space; four readings are four and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes or the boy's own kept gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). The burned-slate word stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four; no sixth is due on a day that has not earned one, no witness stands, no hand is named at the flame, and the seed waits on the far-off calling-in of Jorra's promise, not a confession and not a payment (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid). Ilva's ninth hand stays nine with the strip in her sleeve and no tenth; the row stays at five askings with one shaping and no witness; the well-saying at three shapings; the shut-room tellings at two; the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the cold foot below the sill the cold to one woman and weather to the yard, carried uncured with no recognition, silt-leach, cause or cure; the reed-cutter's cord and the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate held on their own places — none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment (T080, T101, T064, T036/T076, T050/T051, T033/T034, T078, T099, T090, T093/T094/T096 held). Garl stays in objects and not in a story: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease on its peg, the wheel-seat with its twenty-year lean and hollow that Sella lets no one fill, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw unswept both, his proverb to the pot and the fire, and the debt against a firing of tiles circling without a name and worse for being uncalled; his name has not been spoken under the roof for three hundred and fourteen days (T009/T013/T092). In the small hours he turns out the file as he once turned instruments out on a towel at the end of a list, laying each thing on its own place and asking nothing of it: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell beside the told; the told figure beside the paid; nine hands with the strip in a sleeve and no tenth; the stayed-at-the-inch object among the answers on the sixth place; the row at five askings; the well-saying at three shapings; the shut-room tellings at two; the pot sayings at three; nine stoppings with no tenth; seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth. Nothing is spent to make a row come out even, nothing stands up as a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule, and no payer is named to any of it (T061/T082 and the held threads above). At the very end of the day the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same low note — a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, carried into neither the carried fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap left in the square nor the river's low over lower. Answer 204 is exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and stands up as none of the things it refuses; no payer is named. The older man takes a clean satisfaction in the keeping of the number, the infant wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped, both true, the second louder, neither winning, and the argument is the work. The hand comes down on the river's note and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Three hundred and fourteen stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath; six months and one hundred and thirty-four days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed; Garl's name has not been spoken under the roof the same number. Two hundred and four honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings stand up as a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Nothing on the fifteenth of Bone was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended.
